normalized_placemark: Covert floatplane landing and entry point
normalized_note: Smoke coasts the BFA-2 floatplane to an engine-off landing, allowing Victor Two Bravo to enter East McFarlane Island undetected through an unlit, disused boat launch.
open_development_requirements: water approach, landing animation, concealment, failure states

normalized_note: Victor Two Bravo moves here after landing. Tripper assesses the island’s physical security and Goldberg-controlled local network while the team reviews and finalizes the approach plan. This is the route-choice and briefing-in-motion node, not a long static briefing scene.
open_development_requirements: briefing timing, route UI, team formation

normalized_note: An expensive eclectic pavilion styled as an Egyptian temple contains a secure office used by Goldberg, optional intelligence collectibles, and a separate unnamed CheyTac M200 Intervention. This rifle is not EXTREME PREJUDICE and may be used to engage Rip’s overwatch position from range.
open_development_requirements: interior, access, intel set, separate unnamed M200 configuration

normalized_note: Optional Regent cache concealed behind a loose stone block in the flagpole base near the western pool house. The loose stone hides a weatherproof package containing one encrypted USB drive and an unsigned handwritten note bearing an unfamiliar symbol and coordinates that do not correspond to any Game 1 objective. Finding it sets the protected cross-game quest state.
open_development_requirements: discovery radius, save flag, Game 2 import, symbol continuity

normalized_placemark: CRIMSON THREE — Lucky Underwood guesthouse position
normalized_note: Authoring-only identity: Dermot "Lucky" Underwood / CRIMSON THREE. Victor Two Bravo approaches along the eastern beach under foliage cover because the main access route is heavily surveilled and protected by Goldberg’s automated defenses. The team enters the northeastern service side of the property through an apparently dark guesthouse. Underwood initiates the encounter with a stun grenade, producing a disorienting close-quarters fight. After defeating him, the player may take his access card and unlock the concealed security-monitoring room. The legal identity and Oscar Four Delta history are not exposed to the player during Game 1.
open_development_requirements: guesthouse floor plan, stun effects, CQB route, access-card fail-safe

normalized_placemark: CRIMSON ONE — Digger Graves main-residence position
normalized_note: Authoring-only identity: Richard "Digger" Graves / CRIMSON ONE. Graves waits in prepared cover on the first-floor mezzanine overlooking the main-residence entry hall. The player may fight him directly or use the guesthouse security room to alter local IFF threat profiles and turn Goldberg’s privately sourced, PANDORA-isolated property-security architecture against him. The architecture is fully controlled by Goldberg and provides no access to PANDORA, AEGIS, military systems or any wider strategic network. Exact automated-weapon behavior, encounter balance and remote-defeat implementation remain open. The residence also contains optional intelligence collectibles before the helipad. The legal identity and Oscar Four Delta history are not exposed to the player during Game 1.
open_development_requirements: mezzanine geometry, IFF outcome, direct-fight balance, automated weapons

normalized_note: Victor Two Bravo crosses the main-residence courtyard and driveway to the helipad, where Goldberg and Stockbridge are preparing to escape. Macmillan/Bishop orders Spook to stand down and grant Goldberg safe passage. Spook refuses. Bishop declares Victor Two Bravo rogue, but the intervention and compromised command situation prevent the team from stopping the helicopter departure. The mission and Riptide Red campaign end on the betrayal and widening West Coast assault.
open_development_requirements: trigger, blocking, protected escape, dialogue, end transition
